segments.JOL.1.1-3: Joel calls the elders to tell children about this event
segments.JOL.1.4-4: Four kinds of locusts eat all the crops
segments.JOL.1.5-7: Drunkards must weep because locusts ruined the vines
segments.JOL.1.8-10: The land and the priests mourn for the lost harvest
segments.JOL.1.11-12: Farmers must wail because the harvest and trees have died
segments.JOL.1.13-14: Joel tells the priests to mourn and call a fast
segments.JOL.1.15-17: Joel warns that the Day of the LORD is near
segments.JOL.1.18-20: Joel cries to the LORD because animals suffer from drought
segments.JOL.2.1-2: The alarm sounds because the Day of the LORD is near
segments.JOL.2.4-5: The locusts look like horses and sound like chariots
segments.JOL.2.6-7: Nations fear the army, which marches like soldiers
segments.JOL.2.8-9: The locusts enter the city and the houses
segments.JOL.2.10-11: The earth shakes before the LORD’s army on a dreadful day
segments.JOL.2.12-13: The LORD tells the people to return to him sincerely
segments.JOL.2.14-14: Joel hopes God may relent and leave a blessing
segments.JOL.2.15-16: Joel tells all the people to gather for a holy fast
segments.JOL.2.17-17: Priests must weep and ask the LORD to spare the people
segments.JOL.2.20-20: God will drive the northern army out of the land
segments.JOL.2.21-23: God tells the land and the people of Zion to be glad
segments.JOL.2.24-25: God promises full harvests and repays the locust years
segments.JOL.2.26-27: God’s people will be satisfied and never put to shame
segments.JOL.2.28-29: God will pour out his Spirit on all people
segments.JOL.2.30-31: God will show wonders before the Day of the LORD
segments.JOL.2.32-32: God will save everyone who calls on his name
segments.JOL.3.1-3: God will judge the nations for harming Israel
segments.JOL.3.7-8: God will sell the enemies’ children to Judah
segments.JOL.3.9-10: God tells the nations to prepare for war
segments.JOL.3.11-11: Nations must gather as the LORD brings his mighty ones
segments.JOL.3.12-13: The LORD will judge the wicked nations like a harvest
segments.JOL.3.14-15: The Day of the LORD is near for the many nations
segments.JOL.3.16-16: The LORD will protect Israel and shake heaven and earth
segments.JOL.3.17-17: God will live in Zion and Jerusalem will be holy
segments.JOL.3.18-19: God will bless Judah and make Egypt and Edom desolate
segments.JOL.3.20-21: Judah will last forever and God will avenge its blood
